title: How to read your IndianOil (SERVO) invoice
subtitle: Distributor invoice from the IOCL portal. Same layout for every SERVO distributor.

steps.text: Quantity: type the Qty (Ltr or Kg) number and choose Litres. PetroMath converts it to pieces (32 L of 800 ml = 40 pieces). If you counted the pieces yourself, choose Pieces instead.
Amount: type Net Total (the amount before discount).
Discount: type Disc. Page 2 (Invoice Annexure) explains it, e.g. HO Promotional Disc.
Cash discount: type Total Cash Discount if it is not 0.
Printed total: type Net Amt. Payable. You can close the invoice only when it matches.

hints.tax_type: IOCL distributor invoices are CGST + SGST
